earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.description: Your delivery-fee balance — held while orders are in flight, released once completed
earnings.howItWorksLead: Your delivery-fee balance — held while orders are in flight, released once completed.
earnings.howItWorks: You earn a delivery fee when the agent delivers the shipment — not when the customer pays — and one entry is created per shipment. What lands here is the fee minus the delivering agent's contracted share, which the platform pays them directly. It becomes available once the whole order completes and the hold window elapses (for COD, also once the cash is remitted and confirmed). A shipment that comes back earns your return-to-origin fee instead.
